notes.title: Elites Unleashed Update
notes.notes:
[h2]The Wasteland Just Turned Deadlier[/h2][p] [/p][p][b]We’ve got a fresh update for you - [i]Elites Unleashed[/i]! 🥳[/b]
While Act II still needs a bit more time in the oven, we didn’t want to leave you empty-handed.[/p][p]This update brings one of the most requested features straight from our community poll: [b]elite enemies and more loot![/b] It was the second most upvoted feature, and now it’s finally here for you to take on.[/p][p][/p][h3]Elite Enemies & More Loot[img src="https://i.imgur.com/3bLphh8.gif"][/img][/h3][p]Most of you have probably wrapped up [b]Act I[/b] by now, leaving the wasteland a little too quiet while waiting for [b]Act II[/b]. Well, that calm is finally over... get ready for [b]elite enemies[/b]![/p][p]Elites spawn just like regular enemies, but you’ll recognize them by their [b]red star icon[/b] hovering above. Don’t underestimate them, auto-resolve won’t work here, and you’ll need to bring plenty of defense cards to survive their heavy attacks.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/CUd2QKm.gif"][/img][/p][p]Of course, the danger comes with rewards. Elites carry [b]exclusive loot[/b], including unique items you won’t find anywhere else. Some are dropped directly by elites, while others wait inside the new [b]elite cubes[/b], glowing with a distinct border. Gear up, claim your prizes, and prove yourself as the hero the wasteland fears once more.[/p][p][/p][h3]Jamaal[/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/ea7ESzm.gif"][/img][/p][p]Whispers in the wasteland speak of a [b]new arrival at the Mind Metropolis Tavern[/b]. He’s no ordinary drifter and has a keen interest in [b]Elite Tokens[/b]. If you’ve managed to get your hands on any, he’s more than willing to trade them for a [b]generous pile of coins[/b]… and he hints there may be something [b]far more valuable[/b] in store down the line.[/p][p]  [/p][h3]Updated Engine, New Skins & More Fixes[/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/mFUgs6H.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve prepared another [b]special thank-you gift[/b] for all our early access supporters:
[i]Code:[/i][b] augift01[/b][/p][p][i](The code can be redeemed until [b]August 31)[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Redeem it, enjoy, and know that your support keeps this apocalypse alive. ❤️[/p][p]But that’s not all, this update brings more than just new content. We’ve upgraded the [b]game engine for better stability[/b], added [b]fresh main menu skins[/b] each with their own unique sound loop, and fixed a few more remaining bugs ([i]including The Man Job side quest[/i]). Step back in, explore what’s new, and keep surviving.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Act II Progress[/h3][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/dNvwKmW.gif"][/img][/p][p]Our new [b]Shelter system[/b] is nearly ready! 🛠️[/p][p]We’ve recently finished integrating the [b]shop[/b] and [b]upgrade mechanics[/b], giving you the ability to push your cubes further - improving production efficiency, boosting stats, and making your underground base stronger.[/p][p]We’re taking a little extra time to polish everything so it launches in a [b]stable, bug-free state.[/b][/p][p]Right now, our focus is on the [b]Communicator[/b], a tool you can access anytime to keep tabs on your shelter while you’re away. From checking on production and scavenging expeditions, to spotting threats before they hit your walls - it’ll keep you connected[/p][p]Once that’s done, we’ll dive into the final Act II quests. The last step before we’re ready to launch Act II![/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for being part of this journey. 🙏  [/p][p]We hope you enjoy the Elites Unleashed update! 😇[/p][p][/p][p][i]If we haven’t responded to your feedback yet, please bear with us a little longer. notes.title: Act II Progress, F.A.Q. & a Small Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone 👋[/h3]

We're back with a small update, some recent progress news about Act II, and answers to a few frequently asked questions. But first, let's go over the changes introduced in this update:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Udgna9U.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Optimized loading screens and a new intro skip option – The initial loading screen is now at least twice as fast! Plus, with the new option to skip intro videos, you can jump into the game almost instantly.
[*]Main menu skin customization – We've heard your feedback about the graphics being too flashy, so we've added new customization options for the main menu.
[*]Updated pause menu – We've integrated several features from the main menu into the pause menu for convenience, along with performance optimizations to reduce clunkiness.
[*]New item: Potion of Resolve – This potion allows you to recharge auto-resolve points.
[*]Improved retreat mechanics – Retreating from a group of enemies will no longer trigger multiple threat reactions. Instead, linked enemies will collectively reduce your overall retreat chance, making the system feel more intuitive and fair.
[*]Top Tony in East Bazaar now sells entry-level rifles and sniper rifles, so be sure to check out his stock!
[*]More bug fixes – As always, we've squashed some more bugs to improve your experience!
[/list]

[h3]🎁 A Thank-You Gift for Early Access Supporters![/h3]
As a token of appreciation, here's a special redeemable code for you! You can use it until March 31, 2025:

🔸 Code: [spoiler]springab01[/spoiler]

Can you guess what it is? 🥳 Hint: Check the changelog for something related to Spring!

Thank you all for your continued support! Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, let us know your thoughts. We promise to respond to all your feedback on our discussion forums as soon as we can.

[h2]Act II Progress[/h2]

It's time to share what we've been working on recently! We're just as excited about developing Act II as you are about playing it, so without any spoilers, let's dive into our latest progress.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gshIxqi.png[/img]

[b]Open-World Expansion[/b]

One of our major milestones: all open-world locations (excluding settlements) are now complete! That’s a total of 8 unique locations, each branching into fully developed sub-locations. For comparison, Act I only had 4 locations, and only two - Community Center and Devfronds was large enough to include sub-locations.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5KYqzyg.gif[/img]

[b]New Story Characters & Quest Progression[/b]

We've also made great progress in character development, completing over half of the new story characters set to debut in Act II! The main quest now extends up to the introduction of the final two caravan members: Jerry and Emilia. Along with that, we've finished all the animations and related content, making them fully playable!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qC4Tobp.gif[/img]

[b]Settlements Are Getting Bigger[/b]

We're making significant progress on settlements too! Wastewood is fully finished, while Last Haven is partially complete. Settlements in Act II will be much, much larger than those in Act I. Closer in scale to Bazaar. In total, 6 new settlements are planned, compared to 4 in Act I.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rcjprnm.gif[/img]

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

Next, we’ll be focusing on:
[list]
[*] Completing the remaining settlements
[*] Expanding the main quest
[*] Introducing base-building mechanics
[/list]

With all that done, we’ll be ready for a new Beta! We can't wait to share more of Act II with you soon. Stay tuned!

[h2]F.A.Q.[/h2]

[b][i]Q: What’s taking so long to finish Act II?[/i][/b]
A: It’s been 4 months since our Early Access launch, and in that time, we’ve already released two major content updates, plus numerous patches addressing bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements, all with your incredible support!

We also took some time off in January to avoid burnout. Originally, Act II and The Dead Await as a whole were planned to be smaller, but instead of cutting features, we decided to expand the scope to the maximum we can handle, including a full base-building system, which wasn’t in our original plans.

To put it in perspective:
[list]
[*] Act II’s map area is double the size of Act I
[*] At least twice the new content, enemies, and challenges!
[*] More mechanics, more depth, and more to explore!
[/list]

[b][i]Q: Are there any more side updates planned?[/i][/b]
A: Right now, our top priority is Act II, and we’re focused on getting it live as soon as possible. However, we’ll continue monitoring our in-game poll, and if a highly requested feature is feasible, we’ll consider adding another major side update in the meantime.

[b][i]Q: Are there any new features planned for Act II?[/i][/b]
A: Absolutely! Some highlights include:
[list]
[*] New cube types, like Church, which lets you reset skill points
[*] New features like the Arena and Base Building
[*] And much more!
[/list]

We’ve got plenty of exciting ideas, but we’d love to hear yours too! If you have suggestions, make sure to share them with us!

[b][i]Q: What’s the best way to help the development?[/i][/b]
The most helpful things you can do are sharing feedback, suggesting ideas, and leaving reviews. They make a bigger impact than you might think! Another great way to help is by assisting new players with their questions, especially since we don’t always have time to respond to every question right away. 

Your involvement makes a huge difference, and we truly appreciate it! 😇

[b][i]Q: What are the post-launch plans after 1.0?[/i][/b]
A: As we get closer to 1.0, we plan to release a new roadmap outlining our post-launch goals. We’re exploring ideas like:

[list]
[*] Procedurally generated areas
[*] Enemies that scale with player level
[*] Powerful new items
[*] Maybe even an item auction system!
[/list]

Of course, we want the community to be part of these decisions, so when the time comes, we’ll update the in-game poll to make sure every voice counts!

[i]Thank you all for your support and patience 🤍[/i]

[b]v.0.8.7.0[/b]

[list]
[b]ADDED:[/b]

[*] Added: Top Tony in East Bazaar now sells rifles and sniper rifles.
[*] Added: Option to change main menu skins.
[*] Added: New main menu skin "Burn".
[*] Added: New main menu skin "Spring".
[*] Added: New main menu skin "Storm".
[*] Added: Option to skip startup videos.
[*] Added: New item "Potion of Resolve".

[b]FIXED / CHANGED:[/b]

[*] Faster loading and optimizations.
[*] Fixed: Shattered Eye piece could be lost if the player didn’t have enough inventory space, as it wasn’t added to Lost and Found.
[*] Optimized main menu items including GameFeed.
[*] Pause screen now contains some of the main menu features.
[*] Improved retreat mechanics: Retreating from a group of enemies will no longer trigger multiple threat reactions. Instead, linked enemies will collectively reduce your overall retreat chance, making the system feel more intuitive and fair.
[*] Fixed: Opening dev console while pressing hotkeys would result in a crash.
[*] Fixed: Blocked hotkeys during cutscenes that could result in a crash or bugs.
[*] Fixed: During Extra Eyes quest obtaining CCTV cameras wouldn’t immediately complete the objective.

[/list]

[h3]💞 How You Can Support Us[/h3]
As a small indie team, there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.
[list][*] If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review.
[*] Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next adventure. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.
[*] Join the amazing community in our [url=https://discord.gg/T9qv7sB]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter[/url] to share in the excitement and get to know other great gamers looking to survive.
[/list]


Good luck surviving!

notes.title: New Encounters Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Our next big update is here![/h2]

Get ready for New Encounters 🥳 the content update we've been developing alongside Act II! This one's big, and we hope it delivers everything you've been waiting for...

Our in-game poll showed that, aside from Act II, more random events were the most requested feature. We couldn’t keep you waiting that long, so we got to work on another major update, that's also adding new minigames and some other exciting features.

Let’s dive into what we’ve been working on 🧐

[h3]More Random Events[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XGS4LHj.gif[/img]

As promised, we've added even more random events, each packed with crucial choices and intriguing outcomes. You might stumble upon a stranded survivor, pick up a mysterious radio signal, unexpectedly face a zombie horde, or encounter a desperate trader offering a mystery box.

Rumor has it that some have discovered fragments of a powerful artifact called the Shattered Eye inside that very box. Collect them all, combine them together, and you may unlock a new power. Whatever fate has in store for you this time, good luck!

[h3]Hit The Jackpot![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IAnpUQU.gif[/img]
[i]Progressive jackpot? You bet![/i]

Introducing Slotomot-Z, a slot machine designed to give you a break from the usual zombie apocalypse chaos and test your luck!

Some of the taverns you’ve likely visited have already installed the Slotomot-Z, including the one in Mind Metropolis. Give it a spin and see what fortune has in store for you!

To bring a touch of shared excitement, we’ve added complementary online features to The Dead Await with this update! We’ll dive into the details below, but when it comes to Slotomot-Z, online players will find something extra, rather than a fixed 50,000-coin offline jackpot, they’ll have a shot at [b]the massive progressive jackpot[/b], which at the time of writing this is [b]89,650[/b]!

[h3]R-QANONOID[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zuIILWl.gif[/img]

You’ve searched through countless PC files in the zombie apocalypse, hunting for clues, secrets, and anything worth the time, yet not a single game in sight. Strange, isn’t it?

Well, that’s about to change! Get ready to put your breakout skills to the test in R-QANONOID. Beat all the levels, and there’s a special reward waiting for you!

[h3]Shoutbox / LiveFeed & Unlockables[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/USYeIe4.gif[/img]
[i]Connect with other survivors out there, our unique approach to all things online.[/i]

Before going into details we want to clarify one thing first so that it doesn't cause any confusion. The Dead Await is and will stay with offline and singleplayer game as the main priority. But, as the game grows with future updates we wanted to introduce some complimentary online functionality that would boost the fun. Things that are online will be completely optional and even then will also work while staying offline.

[b]Shoutbox / LiveFeed[/b]

Let's introduce the Shoutbox (or LiveFeed), a fast and easy way to connect with other players through short messages. Each player can send a message every 30 seconds, ensuring a steady flow of conversation while keeping spam to a minimum. Offensive or inappropriate content will be automatically removed, so please keep it civil!

In addition to player messages, the LiveFeed will also showcase real-time updates on exciting in-game events, such as major player achievements, jackpot wins from the newly added Slotomot-Z, and other noteworthy moments. Stay engaged and celebrate the action as it happens! 🎉

[b]Unlockables[/b]

This update introduces a brand-new type of unlockable: redeemable codes that grant instant rewards! These codes work both online and offline, offering two exciting ways to find them. Some can be discovered in-game during your adventures, so keep an eye out for hidden notes! Others will be distributed online for special occasions, giving you access to exclusive rewards when we decide to share them.

With this system, we can roll out smaller updates more efficiently and celebrate special events with unique items. As a token of appreciation for our amazing Early Access supporters, those who’ve been with us from the start, reported bugs, and helped shape the game... here’s our very first code:

[i]zXfS972jzB[/i]

Redeem it before March 31, 2025 to claim your reward!

We won’t spoil the surprise, so go ahead and redeem it to see what’s waiting for you! ❤️

[h3]New Game Packages[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bkGJhBR.gif[/img]

When starting a new game, you’ll notice we’ve introduced new game packages. The first step toward even more customizable options coming in future updates!

For now, you have the freedom to skip the tutorial and prologue entirely if you’d like. Plus, you can boost your character right from the beginning with packages like the VIP Package and Caravan X, designed to give you extra advantages. These can be unlocked using the new code redeem function, with codes hidden throughout the game for you to discover.

For our returning players, if you’re starting fresh, you can redeem these codes right away:

V.I.P. Package – [spoiler]The0N3nOLy[/spoiler]
Caravan X Package – [spoiler]XCarAVan1X[/spoiler]

We hope you enjoy the new options!

[h3]Act II Progress[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/txZHSB1.gif[/img]

We've made huge progress on Act II since our last devlog! Every location, down to the smallest details is now fully completed, and we’ve officially moved on to expanding the main storyline and introducing new characters.

We truly appreciate your patience and are just as eager as you are to see Act II finished! As we've mentioned before, this chapter is significantly larger than Act I (which is already complete) and far bigger than Act III, which focuses primarily on the final quest.

So far, we’ve wrapped up all new enemies, items, locations, cards, perks, and recipes. What remains is creating new quests, characters, and base-building mechanics, the finishing touches to bring Act II to life!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for being part of this journey! 🙏

[h3]Ambient OST[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/C118xfx.png[/img]

As we’ve been replaying The Dead Await, we realized that while the action-packed combat soundtrack adds intensity, sometimes a more ambient alternative would help create a calmer atmosphere—allowing you to focus better on your card choices.

To address this, we’ve added a new Ambient OST toggle, letting you switch between the two styles at any time during combat. Whether you prefer high-energy battles or a more strategic, immersive vibe, the choice is yours! 🎶

[h3]Updated Save File Format & Validity Checkmarks[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FvEAXe6.png[/img]

We've got good news and bad news this time 😶.

notes.title: Cards & Perks Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Exciting Updates in The Dead Await![/h2]

We’ve been hard at work creating new combat cards and character perks to provide even more options for varied and unique builds. In addition to fresh content, we’ve introduced several new features, including the combat auto-resolve option, which we covered in our previous devlog.

Finally, with numerous fixes and enhancements, The Dead Await is now more stable and polished than ever. We’re dedicated to delivering the best experience possible, and we can’t wait to hear more of your feedback! 🥳

[h3]New Combat Cards[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GvRFllH.png[/img]

We've introduced rare, epic, and legendary attack cards for all weapon types! A total of [b]24 new combat cards[/b] have been added, offering even more variety and power. Now's the time to dive into the apocalypse and search for every Book of Wisdom you can find.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m84mMZL.gif[/img]

Good luck, and may your journey be victorious!😉

[h3]New Character Perks[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5j3ewX7.png[/img]

We’ve added [b]16 new perks[/b] to enhance your gameplay! These new perks give you even more ways to customize your playstyle, making your weapon attacks deadlier, increasing your chances of eliminating negative status cards, turning attack misses into blocks, reducing the likelihood of being crippled, and much more...

With these additions, you’ll have even more strategic options to survive the apocalypse. Get ready to experiment with different combinations and find the perfect perks to suit your playstyle!

[h3]Combat Auto-resolve[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lrK8pSG.gif[/img]
[i]All it takes is one click, and the loot is yours![/i]

While taking down zombies and bandits is always a blast (and who doesn’t love some sweet loot?), we know that once your group of survivors reaches higher levels, things can start to feel a bit repetitive as they breeze through enemies. That’s why this update is designed to shake things up...

[b]Here’s how it works:[/b]

You’ll start with 5 auto-resolve points readily available, and you’ll earn a new point every day. Combat encounters that are well below your level will be marked as safe for auto-resolve, costing only a small amount of HP, ammo, and one auto-resolve point.

Enemies that are closer to your level will be marked as challenging and will require a bit more HP and resources to resolve.

However, if the enemy level is significantly higher than yours, or the encounter is tied to a contract or quest, auto-resolve will not be available.

[h3]Redesigned Enemy Levels[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mbXHT3n.png[/img]

Previously, enemy levels were hidden until the combat encounter, and each enemy had its own individual level within the encounter. We’ve redesigned this system so that now the entire enemy group has a single combat level, calculated as the average of the individual enemy levels.

Enemy levels are now also displayed next to their icons, and you can toggle this feature on or off in the game options for a more customizable experience.

[h3]Dev. Console[/h3]

You can now enable or disable the developer console directly from the game options. Pressing the [~] key will open the console, where you can view a list of available commands by typing /help.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ci7Ap4n.gif[/img]

If you find yourself stuck due to a bug or simply want to bypass a tricky situation, the console gives you the flexibility to do so. However, be careful as incorrect commands could cause crashes. If you're experiencing any issues, please reach out to us on the Steam discussions or Discord, and we'd be happy to assist you!

[h3]New Details[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YnCJca8.gif[/img]

We’ve also added new details to the world, including fresh blood splatter effects, spider webs, and other atmospheric touches that bring the environment to life. Keep an eye out for these new additions as you explore and survive the apocalypse!

[h3]& More[/h3]

Maintaining your sanity is crucial for survival in the game. if your sanity reaches zero, it’s game over. To help you stay on top of your mental state, we’ve added additional warnings when your sanity starts to drop. You’ll now see a bright flash and receive a notification to ensure you don’t miss the warning.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ToD3nb6.gif[/img]

We've also added a new poll to help us see which new features you're most interested in. So, go ahead and vote for your favorite one! 😇

Please keep in mind that [b]The Dead Await[/b] is still in [b][i]Early Access[/i][/b] and we've only just began our journey together! We really hope to achieve much more with the help of our community 🙏

notes.title: The Rebirth Update Pt. II - v.0.7.5.9
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! 😍

We've got one more reason to celebrate because we're rolling out part two of The Rebirth update! This update puts the finishing touches on all the stuff that needed a little extra shine in Act I and sets the stage for the awesome things coming our way. 🎉

Dive into our Prologue and share your thoughts with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682330/The_Dead_Await_Prologue/

[h2]Different Tier Equipment & Inventory Changes[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cAxjz9B.gif[/img]

We've laid the groundwork for item tier system before, but with this update we're now introducing it properly - that means less boring loot and more legendary stuff! All existing equipment can now be found from common variants to uncommon, rare, epic or even legendary. With higher randomized stats the higher the tier is and more sockets for weapon mods.

With the proper introduction of the tier system, we also needed a better way to show and distinguish the tiers, so we ended up with changing the border glow with colors to indicate it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jV39zc2.gif[/img]

More inventory improvements include the new quick-compare function that auto pops up in case you're trying to compare different equipment to already equipped ones. And finally, you can now hold CTRL to move whole stacks at once, whether you're selling, buying, or looting.

[h2]New Enemies & Combat Improvements[/h2]

Encountering the same type of enemies hundreds of times is without a doubt boring and while we're planning to really increase that numbers with Act II, we decided to add more for Act I as well. We've added 3 new bandit enemies: Meat, Zan, Bandito and 2 new zombie enemies: Spitter and Crawler.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vLD7gmx.gif[/img]

After a few playthroughs it was also noticable that players could easily take advantage of high-attack deck builds that allowed for quick finishing all the existing enemy types in round 1, before enemies even having a chance to perform their moves. To counter this, we've introduced a function for enemies to start combat with buffs, e.g. some enemies might now have a guard effect applied which would mean that player'd have to take damage if they were to attack that specific enemy. Besides that, we've also increased the starting block amount for different enemies and overall, we think these changes should make combat encounters much more interesting. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k3PYmHp.png[/img]

We also recreated all the enemy intention icons to be more intuitive, fitting and decided for mixed intention to also show the according values for both attack and defense.

[h2]New Weapon Mods & Caravan Parts[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iYxMDca.png[/img]

There's a rumor going on that traders brought in a whole lot of new caravan parts and weapon modifications to settlements! That's right, you'll now have an option to choose between different part manufacturers, with each promising their own positives and negatives. There's a total of 48 new different parts to choose from in Act I, so the time has come to upgrade your caravan for real this time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4TEf231.png[/img]

As for weapon modifications, there are now 13 new items that can further improve your deadly weapons to slay through the hordes with ease. From blade tips and handles to rifle barrels and sights!

[h2]Rebalanced Cards, Shops, Workshops, Training Grounds & More[/h2]

After some major changes, it was time to rebalance things once again and we've gone through it all. Combat cards were tweaked to make them more fitting for being starter cards as opposed to more powerful ones that you may find later in the game.

Shops, workshops, market stalls were changed to spread the available items in a better way. Training grounds were also changed to provide more variations in cards between different settlements.

We've also adjusted enemy levels in different areas, tweaked XP that's gained and improved the level up formula. You can also except some other minor changes in balance throughout the game, which hopefully will all result in a more enjoyable experience.

[h2]Dismantling Rework[/h2]

Dismantling was originally intended to be much more useful and we've reworked the whole thing to make sure it's indeed useful this time. First of all, it will now require passing of time to proceed with dismantling. This was a change that was absolutely necessary for us to introduce a new type of items - a bunch of junk, that holds no value by itself but if taken time to dismantle it, you can end up with a lot of useful random materials.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wgjZd19.gif[/img]

We've also gone through all the existing items to make sure as many of them can now be dismantled into something useful at least!

[h2]Crafting Rework[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tbGPAHl.png[/img]

Next up, we've reworked crafting to make it more useful as well. You'll now find plenty of unique recipes for special equipment such as Apocalypse Denim Jacket and Monster Pipe that can only be acquired by crafting.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cdgQHsW.png[/img]

To make things a lot more interesting, we've also decided to add special type of extra crafting materials that can't be bought anywhere, but instead can be dropped as loot during combat encounters.

More useful recipes will now available right from the beginning of the game including being able to craft bandages and ammo. Libraries also stocked up on available recipes, so make sure to check them out.

In total, we've added 17 new crafting recipes!

[h2]Cooking Rework[/h2]

As for our final polish regarding cooking - we've rebalanced all the recipes that are available in libraries, you'll now find plenty of them. Though not all recipes can be bought, so exploring every room and corner can now get you some special recipes as well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jfCekCj.png[/img]

You'll also notice that a broader choice of recipes is now accessible right from the start. Despite Angel not necessarily fitting the typical culinary profile, he does possess the know-how to whip up some basic meals, at the very least! 😉

[h2]Seperate Attribute Points & Changes To Level Up[/h2]

This was a major change that we felt was much needed and has also been mentioned by our players as well, so we decided to separate current skill points into attribute points and combat skill points. With each level up you'll now get 1 attribute point and 2 combat skill points to spend.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VfqRRpD.gif[/img]

You'll also get ability points every 2 levels instead of 3. Max attribute levels are set to 12 and combat skill levels to 20. The formula that calculates the XP needed for next level ups has also been reworked to make it so that it actually gets more difficult to level up as you progress, but keeping just the right balance so it doesn't require too much grind.

[h2]Lost & Found[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0UTKHkd.png[/img]

Lost & Found is a new feature that we had to introduce to deal with some annoying issues that would result due to having no free inventory slots. You could always free up space in your inventory and return back to a specific cube to loot from anytime you wanted, but in case of quest rewards or combat rewards, items could get lost with no way of getting them back.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GCZcG3X.gif[/img]

Lost & Found can be accessed at anytime now and it will auto save all the items that were rewarded, but couldn't be retrieved at that time.

So, you can now go ahead and fight as many zombies as you want with a full inventory, without the fear of missing out any valuable items!

[h2]Fixed Plus Randomized Loot[/h2]

Before Part II of The Rebirth update every lootable cube had fixed loot that we set up manually in order to make sure there was a good level of balance kept, but we always wanted to have some extra random loot too, so that not all playthroughs would be the same.

We came up with a solution that combines the best from the both worlds, fixed plus randomized loot. Each cube can now be created with a variable set to control the random loot amount, level, etc. So that there's always a chance to find something great without keeping things out of balance. 

[h2]Important Changes[/h2]

There are some other major changes that we thought was necessary once again and we'll try to cover them all here.

[h3]Silhouettes At Camp[/h3]

Some of you have mentioned that it acted as some kind of spoiler that you could see silhouettes of locked survivors right from the start. We also agreed, but since it required a major code rewrite, we couldn't do it sooner.

[h3]Equipping Same Type of Weapons[/h3]

You could previously equip the same type of weapons for both primary and secondary options without suffering any penalties. This could result in an unintended and unfair edge even in the beginning stage of the game.

We decided to reduce the attack power by -65% for the secondary slot if the player is dual wielding and calculate the average of other stats such as accuracy. 

[h3]Radar/Minimap Improvements[/h3]

Radar's been improved too - it can now show you if you're in a safe zone or not. If not, it will also display the total number of enemies in the scanning radius and the threat level (expected enemy levels) of the current area.

[h3]More Helpful Journal Tips[/h3]

We've added lots of new helpful journal tips and made sure to cover all aspects of gameplay mechanics. So, new players shouldn't be as confused anymore.

[h3]Enemy Sound Effects[/h3]

Finally, combat is no longer silent when it comes to enemy's turn. We've added fresh new sfx to fit each type of enemy.

[h3]Supply Burn Rate[/h3]

Supply burn rate will now increase with each new team member added.

[h3]Reworked Chained Enemies[/h3]

Chained enemies should now indicate more enemy waves and a tougher battle, they are also easier to spot with changed icons and now link to actual parent enemy.

[h2]Thank You![/h2]

Thank you again to all of you for your support, feedback, suggestions and patience! Make sure to read the changelog, and if you manage to come across a bug that's not listed here, please do report it to us! 😇

[b]NOTE REGARDING THIS UPDATE: Because of some major changes, the update will erase older version save files automatically.[/b]

Have fun! 🥳

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter[/url] for updates and join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/T9qv7sB]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks and share your feedback!

notes.title: The Rebirth Update - v.0.7.0.0
notes.notes:
Welcome back, survivors! 💪

We know, we know... we've gone into radio silence for a while now, but we've been working hard on TDA. The wait is finally over now and we've prepared another big update for you - The Rebirth Update (v.0.7.0.0).

Dive into our Prologue and share your thoughts with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682330/The_Dead_Await_Prologue/

We've taken notes of all your feedback, suggestions, ideas then mixed them with our own and turned it into a one huge update. 

[h2]Discovery Bonus[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/c0cb13ee7ddd7a2148d72e0eb7685e33e8d2fc95.png[/img]

Cooking during the zombie apocalypse is a blast, but you know what would make it even more awesome? If every time you whip up a new recipe, you get some cool, permanent bonuses. That's where the Discovery Bonus comes in – giving you extra perks to enjoy.

Just go through all the recipes and cook each one to score some sweet, permanent stat boosts. It's not just about surviving; it's about rocking it in the camp amid all the zombie craziness. So, let's turn those canned goods into tasty treats and enjoy the bonuses that come with each new dish.

Get ready to spice up your cooking game! 🍕

[h2]Localization[/h2]

We've laid the groundwork for localization, did a bunch of hard work, and now every bit of text is directly linked to localized functions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/66bb1d5dec175c3c8efbf3e67e589a8109b6cb2e.png[/img]

We're extremely happy and excited to announce that our prologue is now available in both Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

[h2]New Quests, NPCs & Locations[/h2]

We've been super busy these past few months getting all the cool stuff for Act I ready. And guess what? It's all set and we're so excited for you to check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/c9904041f0b47772ebfc012c6d11bf179d9a1fb2.png[/img]

We've thrown in 10 brand new quests, introduced 12 new characters to the story, and dropped 9 fresh locations – all in Act I! Enjoy the adventure!

[h2]More Cubes & Items[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/0a0a39499bc256596251caa7080fe045bb0cf9ab.png[/img]

While we were busy crafting new spots to explore, we didn't stop at just creating locations. We went the extra mile and designed more than 25 new cubes to make each place feel extra unique. So, you'll notice a bunch of different styles and vibes as you venture through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40818348/caf7fcc3bb17b47543f9ea624963e6b96df96caa.png[/img]

And here's the really exciting part – with all these new additions, the grand total of items you can find and use in Act I has soared to over 250! That's a whole bunch of things waiting for you to discover and use on your adventure.

[h2]PCs & Hacking[/h2]

We've introduced a new feature – now you can mess around with a new kind of cube - PCs. With these, you can dig through files to find interesting stuff like notes or images. Plus, you can fiddle with other electronic gadgets connected to the same network. Fancy opening locks from a distance? Yep, you can do that too!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/03fcEeP.gif[/img]

But wait, some of these PCs might be locked up tight. You'll need Access Cards to log in, or if you're feeling like a cyberninja, you can use your hacking skills to break into the system. 

[h2]DoF, Improved Transitions & New Options[/h2]

We've thrown in some awesome new visual details, like Depth of Field that makes everything look super cool. And yes, we've also improved how you move between places and game modes – it's smoother now.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R7tIDSQ.gif[/img]

And the best part? You can mess around with all these changes! Tweak them the way you want in the options menu. We even added some other cool options, like mouse lock. So, go ahead, make the game look and feel just the way you like it!

[h2]New Events[/h2]

Get ready for some new stuff happening in TDA! Now, besides the random events that just pop up, we've tossed in some local events too. These events are all fixed and happen once interacted with cubes - then our event and action feature kicks in.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xIHuyAS.gif[/img]

Finish up these local events, and you'll snag yourself some special rewards. It's like a little bonus for getting things done!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

[h2]...And More![/h2]

[i]Oh yeah, and when we say more, we mean a whole bunch more! So, go ahead, grab your favorite drink and settle in for some added excitement.[/i]

[h3]Refreshed Audio & Extended OST[/h3]

We played around with the sounds to make them cooler, threw in some fresh effects to spice things up, and made our awesome soundtrack even longer. Now, it all sounds better than ever!

[h3]Tons of Bug Fixes & Adjustments[/h3]

Most importantly, we tackled a bunch of annoying bugs, crashes, and blockers that were causing trouble. After some serious fixing, we made the gameplay a whole lot smoother. Now, you can dive into the game without those pesky interruptions.

[h3]Balancing Changes[/h3]

After testing things out, we saw that leveling up early on was a bit too simple. So, we've made some changes to even things out. We also tweaked the balance in different parts of the game, like various stats, to make sure everything's fair and square.

[h3]More Tips![/h3]

We've added a lot of new tips to our in-game catalogue of tips, making it way better at explaining how all the game stuff works. So, you won't be scratching your head as much now!

[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]

Now, when you hover over NPCs, you'll see their names and what they're up to. We also added neat animations for new waves in combat mode and fixed up various other things related to UI.

[h2]Thank You![/h2]

Finally, we wanted to thank you all for your support, feedback, suggestions and patience! Make sure to read the changelog, and if you manage to come across a bug that's not listed here, please do report it to us! 😇

[b]NOTE REGARDING THIS UPDATE: Because of some major changes, the update will erase older version save files automatically.[/b]

Have fun! 🥳

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/shotxstudio]Twitter[/url] for updates and join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/T9qv7sB]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks and share your feedback!
